0022600177.text: The Knicks (3-4) host the Bulls (1-6) in their eighth game of the season, with New York on a one-game winning streak and sitting 8th in the East, 3.5 games back in the Atlantic. Chicago, 13th in the East, enters on a five-game losing streak, and the Knicks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 133-127 win in Chicago on October 28, following a 3-1 series win over the Bulls in 2025-26. Josh Hart (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision for New York, while Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (hamstring, out) and has Jalen Smith (finger) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision.
